name: Soft Flea Collar for Cats
label: Velvet, black

health-feature.quote: repel fleas for up to 8 weeks

texts.about_this_item: Beaphar soft flea collar for cats with a velvet finish, 30 cm. A pesticide-free formula with the natural plant extracts Margosa and Lavandin oil repels fleas for up to 8 weeks; it needs 5–7 days to reach full effect. Comfortable fabric collar, adjustable to fit, with a quick-release safety buckle that breaks apart if the cat gets caught, and an optional silver bell. Suitable for cats and kittens from 12 weeks of age.
texts.feeding_instructions: Adjust the collar to fit the cat's neck; the quick-release buckle opens if the cat gets caught. Full effect after 5–7 days; repels fleas for up to 8 weeks.
